D3: outline 0.6's 'which is now 127' becomes 'now 128', signed with the measurement: [Q#127] stands at 17-tools.md:50 and 0.6 was never bumped, so the tooth's bound (every marker below 0.6's next) reds once numbering lands. D4: the proof gains a scratch-corpus tooth for 741d's clause 1: two unnumbered open questions are minted 12 and 13 past a record at 5, an answered record at 11 and an outline cite of Q#8 with 0.6 at 4; a second pass numbers nothing; 0.6 at 40 is the floor.
